test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.**

The freedom to browse a secure and __accountable__ online space will be compromised.
solution: The correct answer is: **Irresponsible** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Accountable **means completely responsible for what one does and must be able to give a satisfactory reason for it. (किए गए कार्य आदि के लिए स्पष्टीकरण हेतु अपेक्षित; उत्तरदायी, ज़िम्‍मेदार) • **For example- ***You will be held accountable for your actions.* • Marked option **I****rresponsible **means not thinking about the effect your actions will have; not sensible. (अपने कामों के परिणाम की चिंता न करने वाला, ग़ैर-ज़िम्‍मेदार) • **For example- ***She made irresponsible comments that helped cause the riot.* • Hence, according to the meanings, it is clear that '**Irresponsible**' is the correct antonym for '**Accountable**.' Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let us look at the meaning of the other words. • **Indebted**: Very grateful to somebody. (किसी के प्रति अत्‍यंत कृतज्ञ) • **Amicable**: Made or done in a friendly way, without argument. (सौहार्दपूर्ण, स्‍नेही) • **Liable**: Likely to have or suffer from something. (किसी समस्‍या से ग्रस्‍त होने की संभावना से युक्त) 1af:Taf4, The correct answer is: **Facsimile**
